title: Generalization Error Estimation for Primal--Dual Algorithms in Non-Smooth Regression
abstract: arXiv:2608.13870v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper studies trajectory-wise estimation of generalization error for primal--dual algorithms in non-smooth regression. Motivating examples include \(\ell_1\)-penalized least absolute deviations regression and square-root Lasso regression, where the data-fitting loss is non-differentiable and existing risk estimators for gradient-type optimization paths do not apply directly. We develop a general recursive framework that includes the Chambolle--Pock algorithm and related primal--dual splitting methods. We estimate risk by correcting each in-sample fitted value with a weighted combination of past dual iterates. The ideal weights are Stein derivative contractions and depend on the design covariance. We construct replacement weights from observable derivative contractions of the fitted-signal trajectory, yielding a covariance-free, data-driven correction. translated_title: 非光滑回归中原始-对偶算法的泛化误差估计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13870v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：本文研究了非光滑回归中原始-对偶算法沿轨迹的泛化误差估计。激励性示例包括ℓ1惩罚的最小绝对偏差回归和平方根Lasso回归，其中数据拟合损失不可微，现有的针对梯度型优化路径的风险估计器无法直接应用。我们开发了一个通用的递归框架，包括Chambolle--Pock算法及相关的原始-对偶分裂方法。我们通过用过去对偶迭代的加权组合来校正每个样本内拟合值，从而估计风险。理想权重是Stein导数收缩，并依赖于设计协方差。我们从拟合信号轨迹的可观测导数收缩中构造替换权重，产生一个无协方差、数据驱动的校正。对于高维高斯设计和固定的有限迭代范围，我们证明了...
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于对偶迭代加权校正的通用框架，用于非光滑回归中原始-对偶算法的泛化误差估计，无需协方差信息即可实现数据驱动的风险校正。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a general framework for estimating generalization error in primal-dual algorithms for non-smooth regression via weighted corrections from dual iterates, enabling covariance-free data-driven risk estimation.
